boundaries: Primary-source verification establishes the bounded facts recorded here; it does not convert vendor, project, or author evaluations into independent reproduction.

artifact.canonical_name: Google DeepMind H2 world-model, robotics, and agent research

sources.title: Primary source 1: https://deepmind.google/blog/
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: Google DeepMind announced Genie 3 on August 5 as a real-time interactive world model.

Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 1.5 and Robotics-ER 1.5 on September 25, pairing physical action with embodied reasoning/tool use; Robotics-ER 1.5 was made available via the Gemini API while Robotics 1.5 was limited to select partners.
SIMA 2 on November 13 integrated Gemini reasoning into a 3D-world agent, and Gemini 3 followed on November 18 as a broader frontier-model release.
